description: Forty new Korean-primary candidate questions for the final proof-of-concept evaluation. English text is reviewer guidance only.

questions.question_ko: 전체 사고 건수와 총 사망자 수는 각각 얼마인가요?
questions.question_en: What are the total numbers of accidents and fatalities?
questions.source_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS accidents, SUM(fatalities) AS fatalities FROM accidents

questions.question_ko: 터널 종류별 사고 건수와 사망자 수를 비교해 주세요.
questions.question_en: Compare accident and fatality counts by tunnel type.
questions.source_sql: SELECT tunnel_type, COUNT(*) AS accidents, SUM(fatalities) AS fatalities FROM accidents GROUP BY tunnel_type ORDER BY fatalities DESC, accidents DESC, tunnel_type

questions.question_ko: 철도터널에서 가장 많이 발생한 사고종류 5개와 건수를 알려주세요.
questions.question_en: List the five most frequent accident types in railway tunnels and their counts.
questions.source_sql: SELECT accident_type, COUNT(*) AS cases FROM accidents WHERE tunnel_type='철도터널' GROUP BY accident_type ORDER BY cases DESC, accident_type LIMIT 5

questions.question_ko: 사고가 10건 이상 발생한 작업프로세스와 건수를 내림차순으로 알려주세요.
questions.question_en: List work processes with at least 10 accidents, in descending order.
questions.source_sql: SELECT work_process, COUNT(*) AS cases FROM accidents GROUP BY work_process HAVING COUNT(*)>=10 ORDER BY cases DESC, work_process

questions.question_ko: 해체작업 중 발생한 사고를 사고종류별로 집계해 주세요.
questions.question_en: Aggregate dismantling-work accidents by accident type.
questions.source_sql: SELECT accident_type, COUNT(*) AS cases FROM accidents WHERE work_process='해체작업' GROUP BY accident_type ORDER BY cases DESC, accident_type

questions.question_ko: 설계오류와 시공오류 각각의 사고 건수와 사망자 수는 얼마인가요?
questions.question_en: How many accidents and fatalities are associated with design errors and construction errors?
questions.source_sql: SELECT cause_l1, COUNT(*) AS cases, SUM(fatalities) AS fatalities FROM accidents GROUP BY cause_l1 ORDER BY cases DESC

questions.question_ko: 사망사고에서 사고객체 대분류별 사고 건수와 사망자 수를 알려주세요.
questions.question_en: For fatal accidents, report cases and fatalities by top-level accident object.
questions.source_sql: SELECT object_l1, COUNT(*) AS cases, SUM(fatalities) AS fatalities FROM accidents WHERE fatalities>0 GROUP BY object_l1 ORDER BY cases DESC, object_l1

questions.question_ko: 도로터널 사고에서 가장 빈번한 사고객체 소분류 5개와 건수를 알려주세요.
questions.question_en: List the five most frequent lower-level accident objects in road-tunnel accidents.
questions.source_sql: SELECT object_l2, COUNT(*) AS cases FROM accidents WHERE tunnel_type='도로터널' GROUP BY object_l2 ORDER BY cases DESC, object_l2 LIMIT 5

questions.question_ko: '작업순서 미준수'가 속한 모든 원인 경로와 각 경로의 사고 건수를 알려주세요.
questions.question_en: List every cause path containing 'failure to follow work sequence' and the case count for each path.
questions.reference_note: The repeated L3 name must remain separated by its two L2 parents.
questions.source_sql: SELECT cause_l1, cause_l2, cause_l3, COUNT(*) AS cases FROM accidents WHERE cause_l3='작업순서 미준수' GROUP BY cause_l1,cause_l2,cause_l3 ORDER BY cause_l2

questions.question_ko: '기계장비관리 미흡' 원인과 연결된 작업프로세스와 사고 건수를 모두 알려주세요.
questions.question_en: List all work processes connected to inadequate equipment management and their case counts.
questions.source_sql: SELECT work_process, COUNT(*) AS cases FROM accidents WHERE cause_l2='기계장비관리 미흡' GROUP BY work_process ORDER BY cases DESC, work_process

questions.question_ko: 모든 사망사고의 사례번호와 전체 원인 경로(대분류-중분류-소분류)를 보여주세요.
questions.question_en: Show each fatal case ID with its full L1-L2-L3 cause path.
questions.source_sql: SELECT case_id, fatalities, cause_l1, cause_l2, cause_l3 FROM accidents WHERE fatalities>0 ORDER BY case_id

questions.question_ko: '작업자 통제 미흡'과 연결된 사고종류와 각 건수를 알려주세요.
questions.question_en: Which accident types are connected to inadequate worker control, and how many cases of each?
questions.source_sql: SELECT accident_type, COUNT(*) AS cases FROM accidents WHERE cause_l3='작업자 통제 미흡' GROUP BY accident_type ORDER BY cases DESC, accident_type

questions.question_ko: 사고객체 대분류 '가시설' 아래의 모든 소분류와 연결된 사고 건수를 알려주세요.
questions.question_en: List every lower-level object under temporary facilities and its linked accident count.
questions.source_sql: SELECT object_l2, COUNT(*) AS cases FROM accidents WHERE object_l1='가시설' GROUP BY object_l2 ORDER BY cases DESC, object_l2

questions.question_ko: '설계오류' 아래의 모든 중분류-소분류 원인 경로와 사고 건수를 보여주세요.
questions.question_en: Show every L2-L3 cause path under design error and its case count.
questions.source_sql: SELECT cause_l1, cause_l2, cause_l3, COUNT(*) AS cases FROM accidents WHERE cause_l1='설계오류' GROUP BY cause_l1,cause_l2,cause_l3 ORDER BY cause_l2,cause_l3

questions.question_ko: '안전환경 미제공' 원인과 연결된 터널 종류별 사고 건수를 알려주세요.
questions.question_en: Report accident counts by tunnel type connected to failure to provide a safe environment.
questions.source_sql: SELECT tunnel_type, COUNT(*) AS cases FROM accidents WHERE cause_l2='안전환경 미제공' GROUP BY tunnel_type ORDER BY cases DESC, tunnel_type

questions.question_ko: 감전 사고의 사례번호, 작업프로세스, 전체 원인 경로를 알려주세요.
questions.question_en: For electric-shock accidents, give the case ID, work process, and full cause path.
questions.source_sql: SELECT case_id, work_process, cause_l1, cause_l2, cause_l3 FROM accidents WHERE accident_type='감전' ORDER BY case_id

questions.question_ko: '건설기계-굴착기' 객체 경로와 '시공오류-안전수칙 미준수-작업자 부주의' 원인 경로가 동시에 연결된 사례번호를 알려주세요.
questions.question_en: List cases linked to both the Construction equipment-Excavator object path and the specified construction-error cause path.
questions.source_sql: SELECT case_id FROM accidents WHERE object_l1='건설기계' AND object_l2='굴착기' AND cause_l1='시공오류' AND cause_l2='안전수칙 미준수' AND cause_l3='작업자 부주의' ORDER BY case_id

questions.question_ko: 둘 이상의 중분류 원인 아래에 나타나는 동일한 소분류 원인 이름이 있나요? 해당 이름과 상위 중분류를 알려주세요.
questions.question_en: Does any L3 cause name occur under more than one L2 parent? Give the name and its parents.
questions.source_sql: SELECT cause_l3, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT cause_l2) AS parents, COUNT(DISTINCT cause_l2) AS parent_count FROM accidents GROUP BY cause_l3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cause_l2)>1 ORDER BY cause_l3

questions.question_ko: 굴착작업 중 토사나 암반과 관련해 발생한 사고 사례와 재발방지대책을 알려주세요.
questions.question_en: Find accidents involving soil or rock during excavation and report their prevention measures.
questions.reference_note: Reference IDs are seeds; assess additional retrieved cases for semantic relevance.
questions.source_sql: SELECT case_id FROM accidents WHERE work_process='굴착작업' AND object_l1='토사 및 암반' ORDER BY case_id

questions.question_ko: 고소작업차에서 떨어진 사고 사례와 재발방지대책을 알려주세요.
questions.question_en: Find fall cases involving aerial work platforms and report prevention measures.
questions.reference_note: Reference IDs are seeds; assess additional retrieved cases for semantic relevance.
questions.source_sql: SELECT case_id FROM accidents WHERE object_l2='고소작업차(고소작업대 등)' AND accident_type='떨어짐' ORDER BY case_id

questions.question_ko: 절단작업 중 절단·베임 사고 사례와 시행된 예방대책을 알려주세요.
questions.question_en: Find cutting or laceration cases during cutting work and report the prevention measures.
questions.reference_note: Reference IDs are seeds; assess additional retrieved cases for semantic relevance.
questions.source_sql: SELECT case_id FROM accidents WHERE work_process='절단작업' AND accident_type='절단, 베임' ORDER BY case_id

questions.question_ko: 정비작업 중 기계에 끼인 사고 사례와 사고 후 조치 및 예방대책을 알려주세요.
questions.question_en: Find caught-in accidents during maintenance and report post-accident actions and prevention measures.
questions.reference_note: Reference IDs are seeds; assess additional retrieved cases for semantic relevance.
questions.source_sql: SELECT case_id FROM accidents WHERE work_process='정비작업' AND accident_type='끼임' ORDER BY case_id

questions.question_ko: 터널공사 화재 사고 사례별 사고경위, 사고 후 조치, 재발방지대책을 알려주세요.
questions.question_en: For tunnel-construction fire cases, report the narrative, response, and prevention measures.
questions.reference_note: The structured set contains all cases classified as fire.
questions.source_sql: SELECT case_id FROM accidents WHERE accident_type='화재' ORDER BY case_id

questions.question_ko: 감전 사고 사례에서 무슨 일이 있었고 어떤 조치와 예방대책이 시행되었나요?
questions.question_en: What happened in the electric-shock case, and what response and prevention measures were taken?
questions.reference_note: The structured set contains all cases classified as electric shock.
questions.source_sql: SELECT case_id FROM accidents WHERE accident_type='감전' ORDER BY case_id

questions.question_ko: 자재 운반작업 중 발생한 사고 사례와 재발방지대책을 알려주세요.
questions.question_en: Find accidents during material transport and report prevention measures.
questions.reference_note: Reference IDs are structured seeds; semantic relevance still requires review.
questions.source_sql: SELECT case_id, accident_type FROM accidents WHERE work_process='운반작업' AND object_l2='자재' ORDER BY case_id

questions.question_ko: 작업자가 이동 중 넘어졌던 사례와 공통적인 재발방지대책을 알려주세요.
questions.question_en: Find cases where workers fell on the same level while moving and summarize common prevention measures.
questions.reference_note: The structured set is broad; relevance and synthesis require human assessment.
questions.source_sql: SELECT case_id FROM accidents WHERE work_process='이동' AND accident_type='넘어짐' ORDER BY case_id

questions.question_ko: 비계에서 떨어진 사고 사례와 사고 원인 및 예방대책을 알려주세요.
questions.question_en: Find fall cases involving scaffolding and report their causes and prevention measures.
questions.reference_note: Reference IDs are seeds; assess additional retrieved cases for semantic relevance.
questions.source_sql: SELECT case_id FROM accidents WHERE object_l2='비계' AND accident_type='떨어짐' ORDER BY case_id

questions.question_ko: 타설작업 중 거푸집이나 콘크리트와 관련된 사고 사례와 예방대책을 알려주세요.
questions.question_en: Find concreting-work accidents involving formwork or concrete and report prevention measures.
questions.reference_note: Reference IDs are seeds; assess additional retrieved cases for semantic relevance.
questions.source_sql: SELECT case_id FROM accidents WHERE work_process='타설작업' AND object_l2 IN ('거푸집','콘크리트') ORDER BY case_id

questions.question_ko: 철도터널에서 가장 흔한 사고종류와 건수를 확인하고, 해당 사고의 실제 사례와 예방대책을 제시해 주세요.
questions.question_en: Identify the most common accident type in railway tunnels, then cite real cases and prevention measures.
questions.reference_note: The count is exact; case relevance and prevention grounding require human review.
questions.source_sql: SELECT accident_type, COUNT(*) AS cases FROM accidents WHERE tunnel_type='철도터널' GROUP BY accident_type ORDER BY cases DESC, accident_type LIMIT 1

questions.question_ko: 사망사고를 원인 중분류별로 순위화하고, 가장 많은 원인의 실제 사례와 예방대책을 제시해 주세요.
questions.question_en: Rank fatal accidents by L2 cause, then cite cases and prevention measures for the leading cause.
questions.source_sql: SELECT cause_l2, COUNT(*) AS fatal_cases, SUM(fatalities) AS deaths FROM accidents WHERE fatalities>0 GROUP BY cause_l2 ORDER BY deaths DESC, fatal_cases DESC, cause_l2

questions.question_ko: 떨어짐 사고와 가장 많이 연결된 사고객체 소분류 5개를 찾고, 상위 객체의 실제 사례와 예방대책을 알려주세요.
questions.question_en: Find the five lower-level objects most associated with falls, then cite cases and prevention measures for the leading object.
questions.source_sql: SELECT object_l2, COUNT(*) AS cases FROM accidents WHERE accident_type='떨어짐' GROUP BY object_l2 ORDER BY cases DESC, object_l2 LIMIT 5

questions.question_ko: 화재 사고의 전체 원인 경로를 찾고, 각 사례의 사고 후 조치와 재발방지대책을 설명해 주세요.
questions.question_en: Find the full cause paths for fire accidents and explain each case's response and prevention measures.
questions.source_sql: SELECT case_id, cause_l1, cause_l2, cause_l3 FROM accidents WHERE accident_type='화재' ORDER BY case_id

questions.question_ko: '안전환경 미제공'과 연결된 터널 종류와 사례를 찾고, 사례별 예방대책을 설명해 주세요.
questions.question_en: Find tunnel types and cases connected to failure to provide a safe environment, then explain case-specific prevention measures.
questions.source_sql: SELECT case_id, tunnel_type, accident_type FROM accidents WHERE cause_l2='안전환경 미제공' ORDER BY case_id

questions.question_ko: 설계오류의 모든 원인 경로를 제시하고, 각 경로에서 실제 사례 한 건과 예방대책을 알려주세요.
questions.question_en: List all design-error cause paths and provide one real case and prevention measure for each path.
questions.source_sql: SELECT case_id, cause_l2, cause_l3 FROM accidents WHERE cause_l1='설계오류' ORDER BY case_id

questions.question_ko: 설계오류와 시공오류의 사망사고 비율을 비교하고, 각 범주의 사망사고 사례와 예방대책을 제시해 주세요.
questions.question_en: Compare fatal-accident rates for design and construction errors, then cite fatal cases and prevention measures from each category.
questions.source_sql: SELECT cause_l1, COUNT(*) AS cases, SUM(CASE WHEN fatalities>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_cases, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN fatalities>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) AS fatal_case_percent FROM accidents GROUP BY cause_l1 ORDER BY cause_l1

questions.question_ko: 도로터널과 철도터널에서 각각 가장 흔한 작업프로세스를 비교하고, 각 프로세스의 실제 사고 사례와 예방대책을 알려주세요.
questions.question_en: Compare the most common work process in road and railway tunnels, then cite cases and prevention measures for each.
questions.source_sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT tunnel_type, work_process, COUNT(*) AS cases, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tunnel_type ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, work_process) AS rn FROM accidents WHERE tunnel_type IN ('도로터널','철도터널') GROUP BY tunnel_type,work_process) SELECT tunnel_type,work_process,cases FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY tunnel_type

questions.question_ko: 터널공사에서 '막장'은 무엇을 의미하나요?
questions.question_en: What does '막장' mean in tunnel construction?
questions.source_sql: SELECT ko,en,aliases,category FROM glossary WHERE ko='막장'

questions.question_ko: 터널공사에서 '부석'은 무엇이며 영어로 어떻게 표현하나요?
questions.question_en: What is '부석' and how is it expressed in English?
questions.source_sql: SELECT ko,en,aliases,category FROM glossary WHERE ko='부석'

questions.question_ko: '동바리'의 영어 명칭과 터널공사에서의 의미를 알려주세요.
questions.question_en: Give the English term and construction meaning of '동바리'.
questions.source_sql: SELECT ko,en,aliases,category FROM glossary WHERE ko='동바리'

questions.question_ko: '강지보재'는 영어로 무엇이며 어떤 종류의 터널 지보재인가요?
questions.question_en: What is the English term for '강지보재', and what type of tunnel support is it?
questions.source_sql: SELECT ko,en,aliases,category FROM glossary WHERE ko='강지보재'
